$comment: Shared test vectors for the card parser/serialiser (PROTOCOL.md §2). Every platform's unit tests load this file. `parse` cases: input text → expected parsed card or null (not a card). `serialise` cases: card → exact expected text. `work` cases: PROTOCOL §10, the additive work extension — parsed by a second pass, so §2's own cases above are untouched by it. `private` cases: PROTOCOL §11, the private extension — the same second-pass shape as `work`; the two §2 parse cases naming §11 are the additivity claim run through §2's own loop.

deepLink.$comment: t.me post link from TDLib message id: serverId = id >> 20

backlink.$comment: feed description contains `tgsocial: @node` → verified for that node (case-insensitive)

timeFormat.$comment: Relative, PRODUCT §2.3. now = 2026-08-23T14:30:00 local. Largest unit only, floor rounding: now (<60s), Nm ago, Nh ago, Nd ago (<7d), Nw ago (<8w), Nmo ago (<12mo, 30-day months), Ny ago (365-day years). exact = the long-press sheet format yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm.

comment.$comment: PROTOCOL §6.2 — parseComment(text) → {target, body} or null; serialiseComment(target, body) → text

A reply to a private post is not a comment (PROTOCOL §11.5).

work.$comment: PROTOCOL §10 — the work extension. `parse` cases: card text → parseWork(text), the SECOND pass over the same bytes (null = no work card). `serialise` cases: {card, work} → exact expected text, work lines last. `tag` cases: workTag(input) → normalised tag or null. `open` cases: openIsCurrent({intent,until}, today) → boolean. `vouch.parse` cases: message text → {node, does, body} or null. `vouch.self` cases: keepsVouch(parseVouch(text), voucherNode).

private.$comment: PROTOCOL §11 — the private extension. `parse` cases: private card text → parsePrivate(text), the second pass ({node, feeds} or null). `publicId` cases: public card text → privateIdOf(text) (digits string or null). `invite` cases: normaliseInviteLink(input) → canonical https://t.me/+HASH or null. `serialise` cases: card (+ privateId | private) → exact expected text, §11 lines last. `verify` cases: privateVerified(privateText, supergroupId, publicText, publicNode) → boolean — only public → private is provable (§11.3).

verify.$comment: supergroupId is the private channel's own supergroup.id as the reader's TDLib reports it; publicNode is the username the reader resolved private.node through (searchPublicChat), so a private card naming @tgs_elijah is checked against @tgs_elijah's card and no other.
